.subhead::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.card{
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--card),#201710);
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:28px;
  position:relative;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(200,151,79,.42);box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
.card h3{font-size:1.28rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-top:18px}
.chip{
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 15px;
  font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);
  transition:color .3s,border-color .3s,background .3s;
}
.card:hover .chip,.chip:hover{color:var(--gold-2);border-color:rgba(200,151,79,.45)}
.note{
  border-left:3px solid var(--gold);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,151,79,.09),rgba(200,151,79,0));
  padding:22px 28px;border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;
  margin-top:38px;color:var(--muted);max-width:880px;font-size:.98rem;
}
.note strong{color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:600}
.bean{width:100%;height:100%;color:var(--gold)}
.divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;justify-content:center;padding:10px 24px 0;color:var(--gold);opacity:.55}
.divider::before,.divider::after{content:"";height:1px;width:min(200px,30vw);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--line),transparent)}
.divider .b{width:22px;height:22px}
.divider .b.mid{width:30px;height:30px}
.divider .b:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(24deg)}
.divider .b.mid{transform:rotate(0deg)}
.divider .b:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-28deg)}

/* reveal on scroll */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ============ NAV ============ */
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;transition:background .35s,border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(22,16,9,.88);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom-color:var(--line-soft);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:72px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.3rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.brand .b{width:27px;height:27px;transform:rotate(24deg)}
.brand em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:30px;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .25s;position:relative;padding:6px 0;
}
.nav-links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:1px;width:100%;background:var(--gold);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .32s ease}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.nav-links a:hover::after,.nav-links a.active::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.nav-links a.active{color:var(--gold-2)}
.burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:0;padding:8px}
.burger span{width:23px;height:2px;background:var(--gold-2);transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s;border-radius:2px}
.burger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.burger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.burger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:150px 0 110px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 540px at 80% 36%,rgba(200,151,79,.15),transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(720px 520px at 10% 88%,rgba(122,74,32,.20),transparent 60%);
}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;position:relative}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.7rem,6vw,4.5rem);letter-spacing:.005em}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}
.hero-sub{color:var(--muted);max-width:530px;margin:24px 0 36px;font-size:1.08rem}
.btn-row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{
  display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:15px 30px;border-radius:4px;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s,color .3s,background .3s;
}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d8a55c,#a9762f);color:#211305;font-weight:700;border:1px solid rgba(224,184,119,.5)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(200,151,79,.28)}
.btn-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(200,151,79,.45);color:var(--gold-2)}
.btn-ghost:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(200,151,79,.08)}
.hero-cup{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
.hero-cup svg{width:min(360px,80vw);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45))}
.steam path{
  stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:2.4;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:0;
  transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;
  animation:steam 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.steam .s2{animation-delay:1.25s}
.steam .s3{animation-delay:2.5s}
@keyframes steam{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(9px)}
  35%{opacity:.7}
  70%{opacity:.3}
  100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-18px)}
}
.hero-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0;margin-top:52px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);padding-top:26px}
.hero-meta div{padding:0 30px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-soft)}
.hero-meta div:first-child{padding-left:0}
.hero-meta div:last-child{border-right:0}
.hero-meta b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.55rem;color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.hero-meta span{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}
.scroll-hint{
  position:absolute;bottom:26px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  color:var(--faint);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;
}
.scroll-line{width:1px;height:44px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),transparent);animation:drop 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes drop{
  0%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
  45%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}
  55%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:bottom}
  100%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom}
}

/* ============ BASICS ============ */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:start}
.copy p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:18px;font-size:1.02rem}
.copy p strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.facts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.fact{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 22px}
.fact .b{flex:0 0 30px;width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--gold);opacity:.85;transform:rotate(24deg)}
.fact b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.12rem;color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:600}
.fact span{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
.anatomy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:18px}
.anat{padding:24px 20px;text-align:left}
.anat .n{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.85;line-height:1;display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
.anat b{display:block;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:5px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.anat span{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55;display:block}

/* ============ TIMELINE ============ */
.timeline{list-style:none;position:relative;max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 0}
.timeline::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:134px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,var(--line) 7%,var(--line) 93%,transparent);
}
.tl-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:30px;padding:20px 0;position:relative}
.tl-item::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:129px;top:38px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(200,151,79,.14);
}
.tl-year{font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--gold-2);text-align:right;font-size:1.02rem;padding-top:5px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.tl-body h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:7px}
.tl-body p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;max-width:560px}

/* ============ SPECIES ============ */
.cols-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px}
.spec{padding:34px}
.spec-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-bottom:6px}
.spec-top h3{font-size:1.55rem}
.spec-latin{font-style:italic;color:var(--faint);font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:18px;display:block}
.spec-badge{
  flex:0 0 auto;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);
  border:1px solid rgba(200,151,79,.4);padding:5px 12px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;
}
.spec dl{margin-top:14px}
.spec .row{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-soft);font-size:.92rem}
.spec .row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.spec dt{flex:0 0 108px;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem;padding-top:3px}
.spec dd{color:var(--muted)}
.spec dd b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.spec .accent{width:36px;height:36px;opacity:.55;flex:0 0 auto}
.spec .accent.a{transform:rotate(24deg)}
.spec .accent.r{transform:rotate(-28deg)}

/* ============ ROAST ============ */
.roast-scale{margin:26px 6px 44px}
.roast-labels{position:relative;height:24px;margin-bottom:12px}
.roast-labels span{position:absolute;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2)}
.roast-track{
  height:16px;border-radius:99px;position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e0c092 0%,#bd8c54 24%,#8a5a2e 48%,#5a3a1c 74%,#241509 100%);
  border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  box-shadow:inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.roast-track i{
  position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);
  border:3px solid var(--gold-2);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
}
.roast-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
.roast-card .tag{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.roast-card h3{font-size:1.3rem}
.roast-card .motto{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2);font-size:.95rem;margin:10px 0 12px}
.roast-swatch{height:8px;border-radius:99px;margin-top:20px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.sw-light{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d3ab77,#b98a52)}
.sw-medium{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#96632f,#6b4423)}
.sw-dark{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#452a13,#241509)}

/* ============ BREWING ============ */
.methods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
.method{padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.method .mhead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.method h3{font-size:1.35rem}
.method .mno{font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--faint);font-size:1rem}
.method .msub{font-style:italic;font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:.9rem;margin:2px 0 16px}
.specs{list-style:none;margin-top:6px}
.specs li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-soft);font-size:.88rem}
.specs li span:first-child{color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.7rem}
.specs li span:last-child{color:var(--text);text-align:right}
.tip{margin-top:18px;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--muted);border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding:4px 0 4px 14px;line-height:1.6}
.tip b{color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:600}

/* calculator */
.calc{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:44px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(150deg,#241a12,#1b120b);
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.calc-controls{padding:38px}
.calc-title{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.calc-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:26px}
.field{margin-bottom:22px}
.field>span,.field>label{display:block;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600}
select{
  width:100%;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#1e150d;color:var(--text);font-size:.95rem;font-family:inherit;
}
select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold)}
.stepper{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.stepper button{
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(200,151,79,.45);
  background:rgba(200,151,79,.07);color:var(--gold-2);font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1;
  transition:background .25s,transform .2s;
}
.stepper button:hover{background:rgba(200,151,79,.18)}
.stepper button:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.stepper .q{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;min-width:2ch;text-align:center}
.calc-unit{color:var(--faint);font-size:.85rem;margin-left:-6px}
.calc-output{
  padding:38px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:20px;
  background:rgba(200,151,79,.06);border-left:1px solid var(--line);
}
.calc-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.calc-num{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,5vw,3.5rem);color:var(--gold-2);line-height:1;min-width:3.2ch;text-align:right}
.calc-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.45}
.calc-label small{color:var(--faint)}
.calc-rule{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:4px 0}
.calc-ratio{font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--faint);border-top:1px dashed var(--line-soft);padding-top:14px}

/* ============ SCIENCE ============ */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;margin-bottom:58px}
.stat{text-align:center;padding:34px 20px}
.stat .num{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.4vw,2.7rem);color:var(--gold-2);line-height:1.15;display:block}
.stat .lbl{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:10px;display:block}
.dials{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:18px}
.dial{padding:26px 22px}
.dial .ico{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(200,151,79,.4);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:16px;background:rgba(200,151,79,.07);
}
.dial .ico svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:var(--gold-2);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.dial h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.dial p{font-size:.85rem}
.fresh{
  margin-top:52px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);border-radius:14px;
  padding:32px 36px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,151,79,.08),rgba(200,151,79,.01));
}
.fresh .b{width:52px;height:52px;color:var(--gold);transform:rotate(24deg)}
.fresh h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.fresh p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem;max-width:720px}

/* ============ CUPPING ============ */
.steps{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:52px;counter-reset:step}
.steps li{counter-increment:step;padding:26px}
.steps li::before{
  content:counter(step,decimal-leading-zero);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2rem;
  color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1;
}
.steps h3{font-size:1.12rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.steps p{font-size:.88rem}
.scale-rows{margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.srow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 130px;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:.85rem}
.srow b{color:var(--gold-2);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1rem}
.sbar{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);overflow:hidden}
.sbar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8a5a2e,var(--gold))}
.srow span.tag{color:var(--muted);text-align:right;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.05em}

/* ============ FOOTER ============ */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);padding:70px 0 40px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(200,151,79,.04),transparent)}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;gap:44px;margin-bottom:48px}
.foot-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:14px}
.foot-brand .b{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--gold);transform:rotate(24deg)}
.foot-tag{color:var(--muted);font-size:.94rem;max-width:340px}
.foot-h{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:18px;font-weight:600}
.foot-links{list-style:none}
.foot-links li{margin-bottom:10px}
.foot-links a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:.92rem;transition:color .25s}
.foot-links a:hover{color:var(--gold-2)}
.foot-links span{color:var(--faint);font-size:.92rem;display:block}
.foot-links .k{color:var(--muted);float:right;font-size:.82rem}
.foot-bottom{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);padding-top:26px;color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;
}
.foot-bottom em{font-style:italic}

/* back to top */
#toTop{
  position:fixed;right:26px;bottom:26px;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;z-index:90;
  border:1px solid rgba(200,151,79,.5);background:rgba(22,16,9,.85);color:var(--gold-2);
  font-size:1.15rem;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity .35s,transform .35s,background .3s;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
}
#toTop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
#toTop:hover{background:rgba(200,151,79,.2)}

/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width:1020px){
  .anatomy{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .dials{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .methods{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
  .hero-cup{order:-1}
  .hero-cup svg{width:min(240px,60vw)}
  .hero{padding-top:120px}
  .roast-cards,.anatomy{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .cols-2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .dials{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media (max-width:880px){
  .nav-links{
    position:absolute;top:72px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;gap:0;
    background:rgba(22,16,9,.97);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    padding:10px 24px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    transform:translateY(-14px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s;
  }
  .nav-links.open{transform:none;opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  .nav-links a{display:block;padding:13px 0;font-size:.9rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,151,79,.08)}
  .nav-links a::after{display:none}
  .burger{display:flex}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  section{padding:80px 0}
  .calc{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .calc-output{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .timeline::before{left:9px}
  .tl-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:4px;padding-left:34px}
  .tl-item::before{left:4px;top:14px}
  .tl-year{text-align:left}
  .fresh{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:680px){
  .methods,.roast-cards,.anatomy,.stats,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .dials{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-meta div{padding:0 18px}

<!-- ================= 01 BASICS ================= -->
<section id="basics">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">01 · The Basics</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">What, exactly, is coffee?</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        At its core, coffee is simple: a fruit, roasted and ground, then coaxed by hot water.
        Everything else — altitude, variety, processing, roast, brew — is a refinement of that single act.
      </p>
    </header>

    <div class="split">
      <div class="copy reveal">
        <p>
          <strong>Coffee is a beverage made from roasted beans — the seeds of a small red fruit</strong>
          that grows on the evergreen <em>Coffea</em> shrub. The shrub itself belongs to the madder family,
          the same botanical family that gives us gardenia and the cinchona tree that yields quinine.
          When the fruit ripens, it turns from green to a deep cherry red, and the seeds inside
          are ready to be harvested.
        </p>
        <p>
          Like wine, coffee is shaped by place. The <strong>“bean belt”</strong> — the tropical band between
          the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn — is the only place coffee grows at scale:
          it needs consistent warmth, steady rainfall, and the cool nights that come with altitude.
          The higher a coffee is grown, the slower it ripens, and the denser and more complex the bean tends to be.
        </p>
        <p>
          That is why a coffee from a volcanic highland in Ethiopia tastes nothing like one from
          a lowland farm in Vietnam — and why, once you understand the chain from cherry to cup,
          every variable you change leaves a fingerprint in the glass.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div class="facts" role="list">
        <div class="fact card" role="listitem">
          <svg class="b" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="12" ry="16"/><path d="M15.5 6.5c7 6-3 11 4 17.5c3 3 6 5.5 8.5 7.5"/></g></svg>
          <div><b>125M+ livelihoods</b><span>People are employed across the global coffee value chain, from farm to café.</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact card" role="listitem">
          <svg class="b" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true" style="transform:rotate(-24deg)"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="12" ry="16"/><path d="M15.5 6.5c7 6-3 11 4 17.5c3 3 6 5.5 8.5 7.5"/></g></svg>
          <div><b>Brazil, the giant</b><span>The world's largest producer, responsible for roughly a third of global output.</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="fact card" role="listitem">
          <svg class="b" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="12" ry="16"/><path d="M15.5 6.5c7 6-3 11 4 17.5c3 3 6 5.5 8.5 7.5"/></g></svg>
          <div><b>One of the pairs</b><span>A coffee bean is half of a seed pair — its flat face is where it pressed against its twin.</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3 class="subhead reveal">Anatomy of the cherry</h3>
    <div class="anatomy">
      <div class="anat card reveal"><span class="n">i</span><b>Exocarp — the skin</b><span>A thin, papery skin, deep red at peak ripeness. Ripe is everything.</span></div>
      <div class="anat card reveal" data-delay="80"><span class="n">ii</span><b>Mucilage — the pulp</b><span>Sweet, sticky fruit flesh. Sugars that linger here become flavor later.</span></div>
      <div class="anat card reveal" data-delay="160"><span class="n">iii</span><b>Parchment</b><span>A dry, cellulose shell that shields the seed and gives it its shape.</span></div>
      <div class="anat card reveal" data-delay="240"><span class="n">iv</span><b>Silver skin</b><span>A papery membrane clinging to the bean itself; mostly sifted away at the mill.</span></div>
      <div class="anat card reveal" data-delay="320"><span class="n">v</span><b>The bean</b><span>The seed — usually in pairs, sometimes a single “peaberry” — ready for roast and brew.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 02 HISTORY ================= -->
<section id="history" class="alt">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">02 · The Story</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">A journey through five centuries</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        From highland goats to global industry — a short history of the drink that
        rewired the way the world wakes up, thinks, and talks.
      </p>
    </header>

    <ol class="timeline">
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">15th c.</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>Awakening in the highlands</h3>
          <p>Ethiopian legend credits a goat herder named Kaldi with noticing his goats dancing after eating certain berries. Whether or not the story is true, by the 1400s Sufi mystics in Yemen were brewing coffee to stay awake for night prayers.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">1554</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>The first coffee houses</h3>
          <p>Istanbul's <em>qahveh khaneh</em> opens its doors: coffee brewed unfiltered in a copper ibrik, served with conversation, chess and music. “Turkish coffee,” the oldest surviving method, still tastes of this era.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">1600s</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>A bitter potion in Europe</h3>
          <p>Venetian merchants carry coffee to Venice; London follows in the 1650s and Paris in the 1680s. Critics call it “the bitter invention of Arabia,” but the salons — and the coffee houses that become engines of the Enlightenment — adopt it anyway.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">1720s</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>One seedling changes the world</h3>
          <p>A young plant carried from Paris's Jardin des Plantes to Martinique becomes the mother of nearly every coffee tree in Brazil. A single tree's descendants now supply roughly a third of the world's coffee.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">1880s</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>Brazil rises</h3>
          <p>Plantations spread across South America, and coffee exports begin to fund a nation's industrialization. Brazil becomes — and remains — the world's largest producer.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">1903</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>Espresso, born in Milan</h3>
          <p>Luigi Bezzera patents the first pressure espresso machine, compressing an hour of brewing into a thirty-second shot. Italy's bars will perfect the rest.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
      <li class="tl-item reveal">
        <span class="tl-year">1971–now</span>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h3>The third wave</h3>
          <p>From a single shop in Berkeley to specialty bars on every continent, coffee is treated with the reverence once reserved for wine: single origins, precise brews, and a conversation about flavor.</p>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 03 THE BEAN ================= -->
<section id="beans">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">03 · The Bean</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">Two species, three paths</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        Nearly every cup on Earth comes from one of two species — and every one of them
        travels one of three processing paths before it ever meets heat.
      </p>
    </header>

    <div class="cols-2">
      <article class="card spec reveal">
        <div class="spec-top">
          <svg class="bean accent a" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="12" ry="16"/><path d="M15.5 6.5c7 6-3 11 4 17.5c3 3 6 5.5 8.5 7.5"/></g></svg>
          <h3>Arabica</h3>
          <span class="spec-badge">~60% of production</span>
        </div>
        <span class="spec-latin">Coffea arabica — the connoisseur's bean</span>
        <dl>
          <div class="row"><dt>Grown at</dt><dd><b>600–2,200 m</b>, in cool, often volcanic highlands</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Caffeine</dt><dd><b>~1.2%</b> — gentle by design</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Temperament</dt><dd>Delicate, slow-growing, sensitive to rust and heat</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Flavor</dt><dd>Bright acidity; floral, fruity, sugary; a long, clean finish</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Curious fact</dt><dd>A natural hybrid of two wild species — its genetic complexity is part of its character</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </article>

      <article class="card spec reveal" data-delay="120">
        <div class="spec-top">
          <svg class="bean accent r" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"><ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="12" ry="16"/><path d="M15.5 6.5c7 6-3 11 4 17.5c3 3 6 5.5 8.5 7.5"/></g></svg>
          <h3>Robusta</h3>
          <span class="spec-badge">~40% of production</span>
        </div>
        <span class="spec-latin">Coffea canephora — the workhorse</span>
        <dl>
          <div class="row"><dt>Grown at</dt><dd><b>0–800 m</b>, in hot, low, unforgiving land</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Caffeine</dt><dd><b>~2.2%</b> — nearly double Arabica, a natural pesticide</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Temperament</dt><dd>Hardy, fast-growing, shrugs off disease and drought</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Flavor</dt><dd>Bold, bitter, earthy, chocolatey; a dense, lasting crema</dd></div>
          <div class="row"><dt>Curious fact</dt><dd>The backbone of most espresso blends and virtually all instant coffee</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </article>
    </div>

    <p class="note reveal">
      <strong>Why it matters.</strong> The species is the first — and the largest — decision in any cup.
      Blenders layer Robusta into espresso for body and crema; purists reserve Arabica for single-origin cups.
      In practice, the species sets the ceiling, and everything downstream refines it.
    </p>

    <h3 class="subhead reveal">From cherry to green bean</h3>
    <div class="methods">
      <article class="card method reveal">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>Washed</h3><span class="mno">wet process</span></div>
        <p class="msub">Precision, in water</p>
        <p>The fruit is removed before drying. The beans are fermented in water to strip the sweet pulp, then sun-dried in their parchment. The most common and most predictable method.</p>
        <div class="chips"><span class="chip">Clean</span><span class="chip">Bright</span><span class="chip">Precise</span></div>
      </article>
      <article class="card method reveal" data-delay="100">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>Natural</h3><span class="mno">dry process</span></div>
        <p class="msub">The whole cherry, sun-dried</p>
        <p>The entire fruit is dried on raised beds or patios, and the sugars of the fruit seep into the bean as they do. Higher risk of fermentation faults — higher reward when it's done well.</p>
        <div class="chips"><span class="chip">Jammy</span><span class="chip">Winey</span><span class="chip">Heavy</span></div>
      </article>
      <article class="card method reveal" data-delay="200">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>Honey</h3><span class="mno">pulp natural</span></div>
        <p class="msub">The middle path</p>
        <p>The skin is stripped, but some of the sticky mucilage is left on the bean while it dries — “honey” for the color it takes on. Somewhere between the clarity of washed and the wildness of natural.</p>
        <div class="chips"><span class="chip">Syrupy</span><span class="chip">Rounded</span><span class="chip">Balanced</span></div>
      </article>
    </div>

    <p class="note reveal">
      <strong>Processing is where place first shows up.</strong> The same cherry, handled three different ways,
      becomes three different coffees — long before the roaster touches it.
    </p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 04 ROASTING ================= -->
<section id="roast" class="alt">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">04 · The Roast</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">Where green meets golden</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        Green coffee is grassy and faintly vegetal. Roasting is where hundreds of flavor
        compounds are born — and where the single biggest variable in your cup takes control.
      </p>
    </header>

    <div class="roast-scale reveal">
      <div class="roast-labels" aria-hidden="true">
        <span style="left:15%">Light</span>
        <span style="left:50%">Medium</span>
        <span style="left:85%">Dark</span>
      </div>
      <div class="roast-track" role="img" aria-label="A spectrum from light to dark roast">
        <i style="left:15%"></i><i style="left:50%"></i><i style="left:85%"></i>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="roast-cards">
      <article class="card roast-card reveal">
        <span class="tag">First crack</span>
        <h3>Light</h3>
        <p class="motto">“It tastes of where it grew.”</p>
        <p>Just past the first audible crack in the bean. Maximum acidity, delicate florals, tea-like body. The origin's fingerprint is preserved almost intact.</p>
        <div class="roast-swatch sw-light"></div>
      </article>
      <article class="card roast-card reveal" data-delay="100">
        <span class="tag">Caramelization</span>
        <h3>Medium</h3>
        <p class="motto">“It tastes of balance.”</p>
        <p>Sugars caramelize, body builds, acidity rounds off. Chocolate, nuts, caramel. The most common roast in the world — the default that keeps everyone comfortable.</p>
        <div class="roast-swatch sw-medium"></div>
      </article>
      <article class="card roast-card reveal" data-delay="200">
        <span class="tag">Second crack</span>
        <h3>Dark</h3>
        <p class="motto">“It tastes of the roast.”</p>
        <p>Past the second crack, oils migrate to the surface and origin notes give way to smoke, bittersweet char and a heavy body. Bold, unmistakable, and — to purists — a different drink.</p>
        <div class="roast-swatch sw-dark"></div>
      </article>
    </div>

    <p class="note reveal">
      <strong>The chemistry, briefly.</strong> Between roughly 150 °C and 200 °C, the Maillard reaction
      and caramelization turn simple sugars and amino acids into hundreds of new aromatics,
      while roasting drives out moisture until the bean holds about 1–2%. The first crack is steam and
      structure expanding; the second is the cell walls themselves splitting.
    </p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 05 BREWING ================= -->
<section id="brewing">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">05 · The Brew</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">Five ways to make a cup</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        Every method is the same act — water dissolving what it can from ground coffee —
        tuned differently for pressure, time and texture.
      </p>
    </header>

    <div class="methods">
      <article class="card method reveal">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>Espresso</h3><span class="mno">№ 1</span></div>
        <p class="msub">The concentrated heart</p>
        <ul class="specs">
          <li><span>Coffee</span><span>18 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Water</span><span>36 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Temp</span><span>92–94 °C</span></li>
          <li><span>Time</span><span>25–30 s</span></li>
          <li><span>Grind</span><span>Fine</span></li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tip"><b>Pro tip.</b> A good espresso should taste syrupy, never harsh — adjust grind first, dose second.</p>
      </article>

      <article class="card method reveal" data-delay="80">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>Pour-over</h3><span class="mno">№ 2</span></div>
        <p class="msub">Precision in a cone</p>
        <ul class="specs">
          <li><span>Coffee</span><span>15 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Water</span><span>250 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Temp</span><span>93–96 °C</span></li>
          <li><span>Time</span><span>2:30–3:30</span></li>
          <li><span>Grind</span><span>Medium-fine</span></li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tip"><b>Pro tip.</b> Bloom with 45 g of water for 40 seconds so fresh CO₂ escapes before the main pour.</p>
      </article>

      <article class="card method reveal" data-delay="160">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>AeroPress</h3><span class="mno">№ 3</span></div>
        <p class="msub">The traveler's laboratory</p>
        <ul class="specs">
          <li><span>Coffee</span><span>15 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Water</span><span>220 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Temp</span><span>85–90 °C</span></li>
          <li><span>Time</span><span>~1:30</span></li>
          <li><span>Grind</span><span>Fine–medium</span></li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tip"><b>Pro tip.</b> There are infinite recipes — the simple inversion method is the most forgiving to start.</p>
      </article>

      <article class="card method reveal">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>French press</h3><span class="mno">№ 4</span></div>
        <p class="msub">Immersion, unfiltered</p>
        <ul class="specs">
          <li><span>Coffee</span><span>30 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Water</span><span>500 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Temp</span><span>93–96 °C</span></li>
          <li><span>Time</span><span>4:00</span></li>
          <li><span>Grind</span><span>Coarse</span></li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tip"><b>Pro tip.</b> Don't plunge to the bottom — ladle over the settled grounds for a cleaner cup.</p>
      </article>

      <article class="card method reveal" data-delay="80">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>Cold brew</h3><span class="mno">№ 5</span></div>
        <p class="msub">Patience, in a pitcher</p>
        <ul class="specs">
          <li><span>Coffee</span><span>60 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Water</span><span>500 g</span></li>
          <li><span>Temp</span><span>Cold</span></li>
          <li><span>Time</span><span>12–24 h</span></li>
          <li><span>Grind</span><span>Coarse</span></li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tip"><b>Pro tip.</b> Steep coarse in cold water, then dilute 1:1 over ice — sweetness rises as it cools.</p>
      </article>

      <article class="card method reveal" data-delay="160" style="background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(200,151,79,.10),rgba(200,151,79,.03))">
        <div class="mhead"><h3>The rule of thumb</h3><span class="mno">∞</span></div>
        <p class="msub">Dial one variable at a time</p>
        <p style="margin-bottom:14px">
          Too sour and thin? It's under-extracted — grind finer or brew longer.
          Too bitter and astringent? Over-extracted — grind coarser or brew shorter.
        </p>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Sour → finer</span>
          <span class="chip">Bitter → coarser</span>
          <span class="chip">Flat → hotter</span>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>

    <!-- Calculator -->
    <div class="calc reveal" role="group" aria-label="Brew calculator">
      <div class="calc-controls">
        <h3 class="calc-title">The Brew Calculator</h3>
        <p class="calc-sub">Dial in the quantities for your method — scaled to the gram.</p>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="calcMethod">Method</label>
          <select id="calcMethod">
            <option value="pour" selected>Pour-over (V60)</option>
            <option value="espresso">Espresso</option>
            <option value="french">French press</option>
            <option value="cold">Cold brew</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <span id="qtyLabel">Quantity</span>
          <div class="stepper" role="group" aria-labelledby="qtyLabel">
            <button type="button" id="minus" aria-label="Decrease quantity">−</button>
            <span class="q" id="calcQty">1</span><span class="calc-unit" id="calcUnit">cup</span>
            <button type="button" id="plus" aria-label="Increase quantity">+</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="calc-output" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="calc-line">
          <span class="calc-num" id="outCoffee">15</span>
          <span class="calc-label">g coffee<br><small>weigh it, don't scoop — grind fresh</small></span>
        </div>
        <div class="calc-rule"></div>
        <div class="calc-line">
          <span class="calc-num" id="outWater">250</span>
          <span class="calc-label" id="waterNote">g water · 93–96 °C</span>
        </div>
        <p class="calc-ratio" id="calcRatio">1 : 16.7 — classic filter strength</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 06 SCIENCE ================= -->
<section id="science" class="alt">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">06 · The Finer Details</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">The science of the golden cup</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        A cup of coffee is a controlled experiment you run for yourself.
        Here are the numbers the professionals keep in their heads.
      </p>
    </header>

    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat card reveal"><span class="num">1,000+</span><span class="lbl">aroma compounds identified in a single cup</span></div>
      <div class="stat card reveal" data-delay="80"><span class="num">18–22%</span><span class="lbl">of the bean's mass dissolves in an ideal brew</span></div>
      <div class="stat card reveal" data-delay="160"><span class="num">98.5%</span><span class="lbl">of your cup is water — treat it like an ingredient</span></div>
      <div class="stat card reveal" data-delay="240"><span class="num">90–96°</span><span class="lbl">the extraction window for most filter brews</span></div>
    </div>

    <h3 class="subhead reveal">The five dials</h3>
    <div class="dials">
      <div class="dial card reveal">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3.5" y="8" width="17" height="12" rx="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="14" r="3.4"/><path d="M12 12.4V14"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Dose & yield</h3>
        <p>The ratio sets strength: roughly 1:2 for espresso, 1:15–1:17 for filter. Fix this first — it changes everything.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dial card reveal" data-delay="70">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="6" cy="16" r="2.6"/><circle cx="13" cy="12.5" r="1.7"/><circle cx="18.5" cy="16.5" r="1.1"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Grind</h3>
        <p>Particle size sets the speed of extraction. Too fine — bitter, slow. Too coarse — sour, fast. Change one thing at a time.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dial card reveal" data-delay="140">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v9.3a4.5 4.5 0 1 1-4 0z"/><path d="M12 14V7.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="16.5" r="1.3"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Temperature</h3>
        <p>Hotter water extracts faster. Below ~85 °C you lose sweetness; above ~96 °C you risk scorching the good notes.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dial card reveal" data-delay="210">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.2"/><path d="M12 7.6V12l3.2 2.2"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Time</h3>
        <p>Time is the result of the other dials. With a consistent grind, a brew that runs long or short is your diagnostic.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dial card reveal" data-delay="280">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3.5c3.4 4.1 5.8 7.1 5.8 10.2a5.8 5.8 0 0 1-11.6 0c0-3.1 2.4-6.1 5.8-10.2z"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Water</h3>
        <p>75–150 ppm of dissolved minerals, no chlorine. Hard water under-extracts; ultra-soft water tastes hollow. Bottled mineral water is a legitimate upgrade.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="fresh reveal">
      <svg class="b" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><ellipse cx="20" cy="20" rx="12" ry="16"/><path d="M15.5 6.5c7 6-3 11 4 17.5c3 3 6 5.5 8.5 7.5"/></g></svg>
      <div>
        <h3>Freshness — the silent variable</h3>
        <p>
          A roasted bean releases CO₂ for weeks, and a ground one surrenders most of its aroma within ten to fifteen minutes.
          Give a roast 7–21 days to settle, store it airtight away from light, and grind immediately before brewing.
          The difference between a bag opened this morning and one opened this week is the difference between
          a cup that tastes of a place and one that merely tastes like coffee.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= 07 CUPPING ================= -->
<section id="cupping">
  <div class="container">
    <header class="sec-head reveal">
      <p class="eyebrow">07 · The Cup</p>
      <h2 class="sec-title">Reading flavor like a professional</h2>
      <p class="sec-lede">
        <em>Cupping</em> — the ritual of tasting raw, unroasted-of-context coffee side by side —
        is how the industry names what it tastes of. It takes six steps, and a loud slurp.
      </p>
    </header>

    <ol class="steps">
      <li class="card reveal"><h3>Sniff the dry grounds</h3><p>Aroma before a drop of water: the first hint of what the origin will say.</p></li>
      <li class="card reveal" data-delay="70"><h3>Bloom & wait</h3><p>Add hot water, wait four minutes. The grounds swell and a “crust” forms on top.</p></li>
      <li class="card reveal" data-delay="140"><h3>Break the crust</h3><p>Stir and smell again — this is the most information-rich moment of the entire cupping.</p></li>
      <li class="card reveal"><h3>Skim</h3><p>Lift away the foam and sludge so you taste the liquid, not the grounds.</p></li>
      <li class="card reveal" data-delay="70"><h3>Slurp, loudly</h3><p>Aerating the coffee spreads it across the whole palate — and sends aroma straight up through the nose.</p></li>
      <li class="card reveal" data-delay="140"><h3>Score it</h3><p>Evaluate aroma, flavor, aftertaste, body, acidity and balance on a 100-point scale.</p></li>
    </ol>

    <div class="cols-2">
      <div class="card reveal">
        <h3>The 100-point scale</h3>
        <p>Cupping scores are the industry's shared language. They decide what gets exported as “specialty” at all.</p>
        <div class="scale-rows">
          <div class="srow"><b>60+</b><div class="sbar"><i style="width:60%"></i></div><span class="tag">commercial grade</span></div>
          <div class="srow"><b>70+</b><div class="sbar"><i style="width:70%"></i></div><span class="tag">very good</span></div>
          <div class="srow"><b>80+</b><div class="sbar"><i style="width:80%"></i></div><span class="tag">specialty — the threshold</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card reveal" data-delay="120">
        <h3>The flavor vocabulary</h3>
        <p>Cuppers describe coffee the way sommeliers describe wine — because, in spirit, it is the same job.</p>
        <div class="chips">
          <span class="chip">Berry</span><span class="chip">Citrus</span><span class="chip">Stone fruit</span>
          <span class="chip">Jasmine</span><span class="chip">Honeysuckle</span><span class="chip">Almond</span>
          <span class="chip">Hazelnut</span><span class="chip">Caramel</span><span class="chip">Dark chocolate</span>
          <span class="chip">Molasses</span><span class="chip">Wine</span><span class="chip">Herbal</span><span class="chip">Spice</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p class="note reveal">
      <strong>One last detail.</strong> None of this matters if the bean wasn't ripe, the cherry wasn't handled
      gently, the roast was careless, or the water was bad. A great cup is not a single decision —
      it's a chain of them, unbroken from the hillside to your hands.
    </p>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var $ = function(s,c){ return (c||document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function(s,c){ return Array.prototype.slice.call((c||document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  var nav = $("#nav"), burger = $("#burger"), links = $("#navLinks");
  burger.addEventListener("click", function(){
    var open = links.classList.toggle("open");
    burger.classList.toggle("open", open);
    burger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
  });
  $$(".nav-links a").forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener("click", function(){
      links.classList.remove("open");
      burger.classList.remove("open");
      burger.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
    });
  });
  function onScrollNav(){ nav.classList.toggle("scrolled", window.scrollY > 10); }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScrollNav, {passive:true});
  onScrollNav();

  /* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:.12, rootMargin:"0px 0px -6% 0px"});
    $$(".reveal").forEach(function(el){
      if (el.dataset.delay) el.style.transitionDelay = el.dataset.delay + "ms";
      io.observe(el);
    });

    /* ---------- Active nav link ---------- */
    var secIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
          $$(".nav-links a").forEach(function(a){
            a.classList.toggle("active", a.getAttribute("href") === "#" + e.target.id);
          });
        }
      });
    }, {rootMargin:"-40% 0px -55% 0px"});
    ["basics","history","beans","roast","brewing","science","cupping"].forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) secIO.observe(el);
    });
  } else {
    $$(".reveal").forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add("in"); });
  }

  /* ---------- Brew calculator ---------- */
  var METHODS = {
    pour:     {coffee:15, water:250, unit:"cup",   plural:"cups",    max:12, waterNote:"g water · 93–96 °C", note:"1 : 16.7 — classic filter strength"},
    espresso: {coffee:18, water:36,  unit:"shot",  plural:"shots",   max:12, waterNote:"g water · 92–94 °C, 9 bar", note:"1 : 2 — the classic espresso ratio"},
    french:   {coffee:30, water:500, unit:"cup",   plural:"cups",    max:12, waterNote:"g water · 93–96 °C", note:"1 : 16.7 — full immersion, heavier body"},
    cold:     {coffee:60, water:500, unit:"batch", plural:"batches", max:4,  waterNote:"g cold water · 12–24 h steep", note:"1 : 8.3 — a concentrate, usually diluted 1:1"}
  };
  var mSel = $("#calcMethod"), qty = 1;
  var qtyEl = $("#calcQty"), unitEl = $("#calcUnit"),
      outC = $("#outCoffee"), outW = $("#outWater"),
      waterNote = $("#waterNote"), ratio = $("#calcRatio");

  function renderCalc(){
    var m = METHODS[mSel.value];
    qty = Math.max(1, Math.min(qty, m.max));
    qtyEl.textContent = qty;
    unitEl.textContent = qty > 1 ? m.plural : m.unit;
    outC.textContent = Math.round(m.coffee * qty);
    outW.textContent = Math.round(m.water * qty);
    waterNote.textContent = m.waterNote;
    ratio.textContent = m.note;
  }
  mSel.addEventListener("change", function(){ qty = 1; renderCalc(); });
  $("#minus").addEventListener("click", function(){ qty -= 1; renderCalc(); });
  $("#plus").addEventListener("click", function(){ qty += 1; renderCalc(); });
  renderCalc();

  /* ---------- Back to top ---------- */
  var toTop = $("#toTop");
  function onScrollTop(){ toTop.classList.toggle("show", window.scrollY > 700); }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScrollTop, {passive:true});
  toTop.addEventListener("click", function(){ window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:"smooth"}); });

  /* ---------- Footer year ---------- */
  $("#year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
})();
</script>
